summary: Ambev S.A. filed its Form 6-K for the month of May 2026, reporting first-quarter 2026 earnings. The release covers organic volume (+0.1%), net revenue (+8.1%), normalized EBITDA (+10.1%), and normalized profit (R$3,832.4 million). The board approved a new IOC distribution of R$700 million payable by December 2026 and set the payment date for a previously declared R$1.2 billion tranche. This is a routine quarterly earnings report under Rule 13a-16; it contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or special-situations transaction. As a foreign private issuer earnings filing, it is mapped to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 2.02 equivalent and is not a special-situation filing.
